edit.description.md:
## Summary
Rename numbered `1_Hero`/`2_Feature`/`X_Jasa` files and regroup from flat `components/` dump into `components/ui`, `components/layout`, `components/sections/*` so new devs can locate code without reading every file.

## Verification
Open repo, tree `components/` — no `1_`/`X_` prefixes, no `misc/` folder, each page section lives in `sections/<name>/` with its own data file. `pages/index.js` imports from new paths and site still renders.

---
**Context:** Flat dump hides seams (`get_architecture` shows 4 clusters but folders ignore it). Order encoded in filename (`1_`, `2_`, `X_`) breaks on reorder. `misc/` is a shallow module that hides cohesion.

**Scope:**
- `1_Hero.jsx` → `components/sections/hero/Hero.jsx`
- `2_Feature.jsx` → `components/sections/features/Features.jsx`
- `3_Gallery.jsx` → `components/sections/gallery/Gallery.jsx`
- `X_Jasa.jsx` → `components/sections/services/Services.jsx`
- `X_CTA.jsx` → `components/sections/cta/Cta.jsx`
- `X_Partners.jsx` → `components/sections/partners/Partners.jsx`
- `X_Workways.jsx` → `components/sections/workways/Workways.jsx`
- `SeoHead.jsx` → `components/layout/SeoHead.jsx`
- `Layout/ScrollAnimationWrapper.jsx` → `components/ui/ScrollAnimationWrapper.jsx` (or delete, see ticket 9)
- `misc/*` → `components/ui/*` or feature-colocated; delete `misc/` folder
- Update imports in `pages/index.js`, `Header`, `Footer` only — no logic change
- Add `jsconfig.json` `@/*` alias in follow-up or this ticket if trivial

add.issue.name: Extract data islands from god components

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Pull hardcoded catalogs out of JSX so content edits don't touch component code.

## Verification
Edit `sections/services/data.js` name/price → refresh `/` → card updates without touching `Services.jsx`. Same for gallery and workways.
---
**Context:** `X_Jasa` 240 lines: 60-line `SUBMENU_JASA` + 4× duplicated card markup + overlay state. `3_Gallery` 26 images inline as default prop. `X_Workways` array inline. Mixed layers — data + view + state tangled.

**Scope:**
- Create `components/sections/services/data.js` for `SUBMENU_JASA` (BANGUN_RUMAH/RENOVASI/MAINTENANCE_BUILDING)
- Create `components/sections/gallery/data.js` for `listImages[]`
- Create `components/sections/workways/data.js` for `workways[]`
- Components import from colocated `data.js` — no behavior change
- Depends on ticket 1 for final paths; can be done standalone with current names if needed

## Summary
One Button component with `variant="primary|outline"` replaces two 95% identical files so style changes happen in one place.

## Verification
Search `ButtonPrimary`/`ButtonOutline` → 0 results. `<Button variant="outline">` and `<Button>` render same as before on Hero/Header/Jasa. Click still navigates to WhatsApp.
---
**Context:** Duplication smell — second copy = extract signal. `addClass` can be `undefined` → class `"undefined"`. `misc/` hides cohesion.

**Scope:**
- Create `components/ui/Button.jsx` with `variant` prop (`primary` default, `outline`)
- Migrate `1_Hero`, `Header`, `X_Jasa`, `X_CTA`, `OverlayJasa`
- Delete `components/misc/ButtonPrimary.jsx` and `ButtonOutline.jsx`
- Fix `addClass` → `className` with default `""`

add.issue.name: Fix Tailwind content config & drop deprecated purgecss

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Fix production CSS purging so styles aren't bloated or incorrectly stripped.

## Verification
`npm run build` → check `out/_next/static/css` size drops, no missing yellow/slate classes in prod preview (`npx serve out` — hero, feature, gallery all styled).
---
**Context:** `tailwind.config.js` scans `*.jsx` only but files are `*.js`; actual purge is via `@fullhuman/postcss-purgecss` (deprecated, clashes with Tailwind JIT).

**Scope:**
- Fix `tailwind.config.js` `content: ["./pages/**/*.{js,jsx}","./components/**/*.{js,jsx}"]`
- Remove `purgecss` from `postcss.config.js` and `package.json`
- Remove `! purgecss start ignore` comments from `styles/tailwind.css` if no longer needed
- Verify build output CSS

add.issue.name: Add missing standard configs & clean dead .scripts

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Add `next.config.js`, `jsconfig.json` path alias, and `eslint` so imports are readable and typos are caught; delete dead base-url hack.

## Verification
`import Button from "@/components/ui/Button"` resolves. `npx eslint components/Layout/Header.jsx` reports `roudned-lg`, `class` vs `className`, `p  y-8`. No `.scripts/changebaseurl.js`.

**Context:** Missing `next.config.js` (replaced by `replace-in-file` hacking `"/assets/"`), no alias → `../../` hell, no lint → typos survive. Hidden `.scripts/` dot-folder is non-standard.

add.issue.name: Consolidate WhatsApp links → factory + constants cleanup

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Replace 18 duplicated `WHATSAPP_MESSAGES.*` exports with one `buildWhatsAppUrl(message)` factory so phone number changes in one place.

## Verification
Change `PHONE_NUMBER` in one file → all Jasa overlay links + Hero CTA generate new `api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=` without editing 18 lines. No `data/constants.js` duplication.
---
**Context:** `data/constants.js` repeats `${PHONE_NUMBER}` + `encodeURIComponent` 18× — hidden globals + update hazard. Each service message differs only by text.

**Scope:**
- Create `lib/whatsapp.js` `buildWhatsAppUrl(message)` / `getWhatsAppLink(key)`
- Create `lib/constants.js` for `PHONE_NUMBER`/`EMAIL`/`ADDRESS` only
- Migrate `X_Jasa`, `1_Hero`, `X_CTA` to factory
- Keep old `data/constants.js` as re-export shim or delete after migration

## Summary
Correct broken OG/canonical tags so shares and SEO show real site name and URL.

## Verification
View source `/` → `<title>`, `og:url`, `canonical`, `og:site_name` show real domain (not `"Trisukses Bangun Karya.com"`), no `Lorem Ipsum` author, correct `theme-color` (yellow-500 not red).
---
**Context:** `defaultMeta.url = "Trisukses Bangun Karya.com"` is not a URL → `og:url` + `canonical` broken. `author: Lorem Ipsum`, `theme-color: #F53838` mismatched brand.

**Scope:**

- Fix `author`, `theme-color` to brand yellow-500

- Add `twitter:card` if trivial

## Summary Remove runtime dependency on `img.icons8.com` and fix `next/image` usage so images are optimized and work offline/static export. ## Verification DevTools Network → no `icons8.com` requests. All service icons served from `public/`. No React warning `object-fit` vs `objectFit`, no `alt="VPN Illustrasi"`, no `srcset=""` empty. --- **Context:** `X_Jasa` loads 18 remote icons (privacy/CSP/offline risk). `Hero` uses raw ``, `Partners` 20× `` without `alt`/`sizes`. `Gallery` uses `style: "object-fit"` (should be class or `objectFit`). **Scope:** - Download/self-host icons from `icons8.com` to `public/icons/` or replace with `lucide-react` / `heroicons` - Migrate `Hero` `` → `next/image` with `priority`, `Partners` → `next/image` with `alt` - Fix `Gallery` `style={{ "object-fit": "cover" }}` → `className="object-cover"` or `style={{ objectFit: "cover" }}`, add `alt` - Fix `OverlayJasa` `srcset=""` and `class` → `className` - Reorganize `public/assets/` by feature (`images/hero`, `images/services`, `images/partners`)

add.issue.name: Deduplicate animation & fix duplicate IDs / a11y

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Remove 6× copy-paste `useMemo(() => getScrollAnimation())` and fix duplicate `id="feature"` + missing a11y so navigation and screen readers work.

## Verification
Scroll `/` → all sections still animate. Click Header `Keunggulan` → lands on Features not Workways. `id="feature"` appears once. Overlay closes on ESC, focus trapped, no `class` warning.
---
**Context:** `getScrollAnimation` is pure config wrapped in `useMemo` ×6 — indirection maze. `Workways` and `Feature` both `id="feature"` → `react-scroll` ambiguous. `OverlayJasa` uses `class` not `className`, `onClick` on `<a>` without `href`, no focus trap. `Header` duplicates desktop + mobile nav 4× `LinkScroll`.

**Scope:**
- Extract `lib/animation.js` const `scrollVariants` or `hooks/useScrollAnimation` — replace `useMemo` copy-paste
- Fix IDs: `features`/`workways`/`services`/`gallery`/`partners`/`cta` (unique)
- Fix `OverlayJasa`: `class`→`className`, `srcset`, ESC/focus trap, `<button>` not `<a onClick>`
- Refactor `Header`: map nav items from array `[{to:"features",label:"Keunggulan"},...]` — kills 4× `LinkScroll` duplication (fix `roudned-lg` typo too)
- Move `ScrollAnimationWrapper` to `components/ui/` or inline `motion.div` with variants

add.issue.name: Upgrade toolchain: Next 12→14, React 17→18, Node 16→20, audit fix

edit.description.md:
## Summary
Upgrade EOL framework and CI images to get security patches and unblock `next/image`/`output: export`.

## Verification
`node -v` 20, `npm audit` 0 high/critical, `npm run build` with `output: export` succeeds, GitHub Pages deploys on push to `main` without manual `next export` step.
---
**Context:** Next 12/React 17/Node 16 all EOL, `actions/*@v2/v3` deprecated, 20 vulns (2 critical: source-map-js, svgo). `next export` deprecated since 13.

**Scope:**
- Upgrade `next` 12→14, `react`/`react-dom` 17→18, `framer-motion` 6→11, `tailwind` 3.3→3.4 (or 4)
- Replace `next export` with `next.config.js` `output: 'export'` + `images.unoptimized: true`
- Update `.github/workflows/nextjs.yml`: `actions/checkout@v4`, `setup-node@v4` with `node 20`, `configure-pages@v4`, `upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `deploy-pages@v4`
- Run `npm audit fix`, replace `yarn.lock` vs `package-lock.json` → pick `npm`
- Verify `pages/_document.js` `getInitialProps` still needed or delete no-op
